summary: McLaren and Ferrari converge on Barcelona's challenging Madring circuit, each sensing opportunity to close the gap on Red Bull's dominance through high-speed corner mastery. Red Bull faces disruption with Isack Hadjar sidelined by a wrist injury, forcing the team to deploy a reserve driver and potentially altering their strategic flexibility during a technically demanding weekend. A strong performance here could reshape the championship trajectory, offering McLaren or Ferrari the platform to launch a sustained assault on the title fight heading into the final races.
